column1: # The exclusions of Spark's expression suites run under Varka (VARKA-368; see VarkaSuiteCheck).
# Tab separated: test name as ScalaTest prints it, suite (the Varka subclass), kind, reason. Kinds:
# read-path - Spark's answer over the rows read back from Arrow differs from its answer over the fixture's.
# lift - Spark answers the lifted expression, its literals columns, differently from the suite's.
# spark - Spark's interpreted and generated projections disagree, so the row is not compared.
# A listed test whose findings are all of its kind is cancelled with the reason; one that finds nothing
# fails as a stale line. A finding of the kernel's is never listed: it fails its test.
